YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy, simply.

The details you share help us plan your event.

Event inquiries

When you submit an inquiry, the contact and event details you enter, along with your signed agreement for hotel setups, are sent to Niagara Wedding and Event Rentals to respond to your request. If email delivery is unavailable, the site offers an email draft for you to send yourself.

Your shortlist

Your chosen rentals are saved in your browser on this device. Contact details and signatures are not saved to browser storage by this site. Signed agreements are delivered to the business by email when delivery is configured. A downloadable copy is generated on your device. You can remove rentals from your shortlist at any time.

Questions or requests

To ask about your information or request its correction or deletion, contact info@niagaraweddingandeventrentals.com.
